title: Titanium Weld Neck Flange
function: Raised face weld neck flange for high-pressure lines
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this pipe fitting application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by raised face weld neck flange for high-pressure lines and specific design requirements.
process: Hot forming plate rolling for pipe fitting geometry
CNC corrosion allowance with 0.5mm corner radius
TIG welding Grade 2 with 0.5mm corner radius
Hydrostatic shell test with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for raised face weld application
commonFailures: Crevice under gasket seating surface - mitigated by raised-face flange 0.5mm step replacing full-face gasket — critical for raised face weld performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Weld Neck Flange suitable for Raised face weld neck flange for high-pressure lines?
faq.a: Titanium Weld Neck Flange uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address pipe fitting operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Weld Neck Flange?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Weld Neck Flange is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for raised face weld requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Weld Neck Flange require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. raised face weld components require Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for raised face weld application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Weld Neck Flange shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Weld Neck Flange includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet raised face weld specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Weld neck / WN flange pipe fitting components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
